newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank starts Three Gorges data net.
newsitem.headline: China bank starts Three Gorges data net.

text.p: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China has set up a computerised information network in central China in a bid to encourage investment in the massive Three Gorges dam project, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The bank spent 55 million yuan ($6.6 million) to set up the network in Yichang in central Hubei province, Xinhua said.
It said the network, which went into operation on Sunday, covers 113 of the bank's offices in the Three Gorges project area -- the world's biggest dam project.
The network would help the bank handle 270,000 transactions a day and would be connected to its national network within six months, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
